/audio/faceplace/kokoro-heart/faceplace-.speechText: venerable. Definition: Deserving respect because of age or experience. In this passage, the battered fish looks venerable with age.
rosettes. Definition: Small shapes or ornaments resembling roses. In this passage, lime forms small rosettes on the fish.
isinglass. Definition: Thin, transparent sheets of mica once used in windows. In this passage, the fish’s eyes resemble scratched isinglass.
swivel. Definition: A joint that lets connected parts turn without twisting. In this passage, a swivel remains attached to the old fishing tackle.
frayed. Definition: Worn so that threads or fibers come loose at the edges. In this passage, the broken fishing line has a frayed end.
thwarts. Definition: Seats or crosspieces running across a small boat. In this passage, the boat’s thwarts are cracked by the sun.
dismay. Definition: Distress caused by an unexpected and troubling discovery. In this passage, the travelers look at the little man in dismay.
meekly. Definition: In a quiet, gentle, and submissive way. In this passage, Oz meekly admits that the travelers are wrong.
humbug. Definition: A person who pretends to be something they are not. In this passage, the Scarecrow calls Oz a humbug.
Platonic. Definition: Philosophical definition: Based on an ideal or abstract model rather than ordinary reality. In this passage, Platonic describes Gatsby's idealized image of himself.
notoriety. Definition: The state of being widely known, often because of rumors or something questionable. In this passage, rumors increase Gatsby's notoriety.
conception. Definition: An idea or mental picture of what something could be. In this passage, Gatsby creates himself from his own conception.
bootless. Definition: Useless or unable to produce a result. In this passage, the speaker's bootless cries bring no help.
scope. Definition: The range of someone's abilities or opportunities. In this passage, the speaker envies another person's scope.
sullen. Definition: Gloomy, dark, or seeming quietly unhappy. In this passage, sullen earth seems dark and gloomy before dawn.
prinked. Definition: Dressed or adjusted their appearance with elaborate care. In this passage, the girls prinked as they prepared for the party.
talisman. Definition: An object believed to bring protection or good fortune; here, something emotionally protective. In this passage, her mother’s note becomes a talisman against envy.
despondency. Definition: A feeling of deep discouragement or sadness. In this passage, sharing the flowers ends Meg’s despondency.
visage. Definition: A person's face or facial appearance. In this passage, visage means the statue's shattered face.
passions. Definition: Strong feelings or emotions. In this passage, the sculptor captured the ruler's passions.
colossal. Definition: Extremely large or immense. In this passage, colossal describes the enormous ruined statue.
infrastructure. Definition: The basic systems or services that allow a community to function. In this passage, social media can serve as social infrastructure.
algorithm. Definition: A set of rules a computer follows to decide what to show or do. In this passage, an algorithm chooses what appears in a young person's feed.
dispositions. Definition: Usual attitudes or tendencies that shape how someone responds. In this passage, personal dispositions can affect which features are harmful.
